sn51.7:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam bhikkhū āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihariṃsu || sabbe te catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā || || Ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam bhikkhū āsavānam khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññavimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissanti || sabbe te catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā
